notes: No BL-generation (2009-2013) schedule for the 1.6 MZR in Israel or Europe could be retrieved: manualslib and manuals.plus returned 403, and owners-manual.mazda.com hosts only BM and later editions. The closest official Israel data is the Israel table in the BM-generation Mazda3 manual 8GD7-EE-17H (15,000 km / 12-month grid). It is a different generation, so flag it before applying it to a 2011 car. The 2011 US document covers only the 2.0/2.5 L engines. Timing drive: Walla says 'ל-3 מותקנת שרשרת תזמון ומכאן כי נחסכת הוצאה גדולה של החלפת סט טיימינג' (timing chain). No source gives a chain replacement interval, so no timing item is recorded. The Hebrew claims each have one source; several Israeli forums returned 403. Intervals derived from table columns (e.g. 'R every 2nd column') are readings of the quoted table row against the column headers quoted in the same source. The Russia/Belarus/Kazakhstan table (MZR 1.6 plugs R every 30,000 km, valve clearance every 45,000 km or 3 years in RU/BY/AZ) was seen but not recorded as an item because that market is not relevant.
